title: Model Evaluation
summary: Confusion matrices, precision, recall, F1, class imbalance, over- and underfitting.
objectives: Compute precision, recall and F1 from a confusion matrix
socratic_prompts: In medical screening, would you prioritise precision or recall? Why?
What does a large gap between training and test accuracy suggest?

examples.title: Metrics
examples.code:
from sklearn.metrics import precision_score, recall_score
print(precision_score([1,1,0,0],[1,0,1,0]), recall_score([1,1,0,0],[1,0,1,0]))
